 AND 4 OTHERS  Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances  stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be  pleased to pass an Interim Order, directing the respondents to disburse  the balance amount of Rs. 28,12,594/- along with solatium and interest, by  passing an Award, as determined in Exhibit P8, in respect to the  residential building, in Sy No. 44/3-4-1 of Pattanakkad Village and the  compensation for his loss of residence, under the 2nd Schedule of the  Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
